base.name: Royal Command
base.text: When Scheming ends, replace a Councillor with an eligible player, even under the King's Seal. They draw 1 Scheme.

hurrem.name: Cersei Lannister

base.name: The Queen's Counsel
base.text: At the Judgment, you choose which Councillor gets the Favor instead of the King.

favor.name: Power Is Power
favor.text: In one wave, play two cards instead of one.

hurrem.flavor: When you play the game of thrones, you win or you die.

base.name: In the King's Name
base.text: This Crisis you name both Councillors instead of the King; you may name yourself.

favor.name: Honor
favor.text: From now on, whenever Fealty is sent while you are a Councillor, gain 1 Favor.

sahsultan.name: Renly Baratheon

base.name: The King's Brother
base.text: On your Challenge turn, Challenge for free and pick the replacement. It counts as your Challenge this Crisis.

favor.name: Banished from Court
favor.text: Pick a player: next Crisis they can't become a Councillor by any means.

sahsultan.flavor: Lord of Storm's End, the King's youngest brother.

base.name: Crown Prince
base.text: When Scheming ends, before Royal Command, take a Councillor's seat if eligible, even under the King's Seal.

favor.name: Mine to Torment
favor.text: Whoever Challenges you gives you the Favor they paid.

hatice.name: Varys

base.name: I Serve the Realm
base.text: Before Scheming, pick a player: this Crisis no Scheme unseats them and they lose no Favor, Judgment included.

favor.name: Little Birds
favor.text: Pick two players other than the King and you: learn in secret whether they are on the same side.

hatice.flavor: A very small man can cast a very large shadow.

rustem.name: Petyr Baelish

base.name: A Quiet Word
base.text: Before the King names the Councillors, talk with him alone for a minute.

favor.name: Chaos Is a Ladder
favor.text: When a wave flips, move a Scheme played on you to another player.

rustem.flavor: I did warn you not to trust me.

barbaros.name: Arya Stark

base.name: Quick as a Snake
base.text: Take a random Scheme from another player's hand, then discard down to your hand limit.

favor.name: Beneath the Keep
favor.text: After the Ravens, look in secret at the card or cards the Hand burned.

barbaros.flavor: Stick them with the pointy end.

gritti.name: Tyrion Lannister

base.name: A Lannister's Debt
base.text: Pick a player. The next time they gain Favor, you gain 1 too.

favor.name: A Mind Needs Books
favor.text: Look in secret at the top 3 Ravens; you may put one on the bottom.

gritti.flavor: A Lannister always pays his debts.

sarlken.name: Jon Snow

base.name: Take the Black
base.text: When Councillors are named, before Challenges, hand your seat to an eligible player. Gain 1 Favor; draw nothing.

favor.name: Beyond the Wall
favor.text: Your Schemes count as cards of an open field.

sarlken.flavor: I am the sword in the darkness.

tahmasp.name: Daenerys Targaryen

base.name: Khaleesi
base.text: When the Crisis flips, you pick its field: Council, Whispers or Red Keep.

favor.name: Fire and Blood
favor.text: Everyone, you included, keeps 1 Scheme of their choice and discards the rest.

tahmasp.flavor: I am the blood of the dragon.

daye.name: Jaime Lannister
daye.text: Play a Scheme as Usurper; you can't pick yourself.
daye.flavor: The things I do for love.

bali.name: Sandor Clegane
bali.text: Play a Scheme as King's Seal.

ayas.name: Ilyn Payne
ayas.flavor: The King's Justice never says a word.

matrakci.name: Ros
matrakci.flavor: Every man talks on the Street of Silk.

sumbul.name: Syrio Forel
sumbul.text: Play a Scheme as Not Today; you pick its field.
sumbul.flavor: What do we say to the god of death?

nigar.name: Grand Maester Pycelle
nigar.text: Play a Scheme as Opened Letters.
nigar.flavor: Every raven passes through his rookery.

ebussuud.name: Jory Cassel
ebussuud.flavor: Captain of the Stark guard, and the Hand's legs.

gulsah.name: Shae
gulsah.flavor: One word from her can hang a lord.

seker.name: Lancel Lannister
seker.text: Play a Scheme as Food Taster.
seker.flavor: The King's cup passes through his hand first.

gulfem.name: Sansa Stark
gulfem.text: Play a Scheme as Tourney Wager.

iskender.name: Janos Slynt
iskender.text: Play a Scheme as Crown's Ledgers.
iskender.flavor: Bought with the crown's own gold.

firuze.name: Loras Tyrell
firuze.text: Play a Scheme as King's Eye.
firuze.flavor: The Knight of Flowers draws every eye.

gulaga.name: Septa Mordane
gulaga.text: Play a Scheme as Hold Your Tongue.
gulaga.flavor: A lady listens more than she speaks.

lokman.name: Barristan Selmy
lokman.text: Play a Scheme as Standing Guard.
lokman.flavor: Forty years at the King's door.

akil-hocasi.name: Not Today
akil-hocasi.text: This Crisis, cancels the other Schemes of its field played on this player.
akil-hocasi.flavor: What do we say to the god of death? Not today.

muhur.name: King's Seal
muhur.text: Place on a Councillor. This Crisis no Scheme can replace them; Royal Command still can.

valide.name: Usurper
valide.text: Place on a Councillor. Replace them with an eligible player, you included. The newcomer takes the same seat.
valide.flavor: What the dragon's heirs call the King.

azil.name: Dismissed
azil.text: Place on a Councillor. The King replaces them with an eligible player; the newcomer takes the same seat.
azil.flavor: You are relieved of your duties.

casus.name: Shadowed
casus.text: When Scheming ends, see in secret which Schemes this player played this Crisis, and on whom.
casus.flavor: Someone followed them all the way down.

muhurlu-evrak.name: Opened Letters
muhurlu-evrak.text: Look in secret at the top 3 Ravens, then put them back in the same order.

saray-tabibi.name: Food Taster
saray-tabibi.text: This player loses no Favor this Crisis, Judgment included.

iftira.name: Rumor
iftira.flavor: A name, a whisper, a fall.

kefalet.name: Tourney Wager
kefalet.text: Place on a Councillor. If still one at the Ravens: gain 1 Favor if Fealty is sent, lose 1 if Treachery is.
kefalet.flavor: Back a champion, and pay if he falls.

teftis.name: Inquiry
teftis.text: Place on a Councillor. After the Ravens, look in secret at the card or cards they burned.
teftis.flavor: The Hand reads what others throw away.

defterdar.name: Crown's Ledgers
defterdar.text: Place on the Hand. If still the Hand at the Ravens, they draw 4 instead of 3 and burn 2.
defterdar.flavor: Six million in debt, every line accounted for.

nobet.name: Standing Guard
nobet.text: When Scheming ends, pick one Scheme others played on this player this Crisis; learn in secret who played it.

nazar.name: King's Eye
nazar.text: Place on a Councillor. If the Judgment falls on them this Crisis, it gives or takes 2 instead of 1.
nazar.flavor: Robert is watching. Pray he likes what he sees.

sukut.name: Hold Your Tongue
sukut.text: This player can't play a Scheme in the next wave.

divanda-nufuz.name: Strip the Pin
divanda-nufuz.text: Unseat a Councillor with a Scheme.
divanda-nufuz.flavor: Even a Hand can lose his pin.

suphe.name: Under Suspicion
suphe.text: Be a Councillor when Treachery is sent.
suphe.flavor: Where there's smoke, someone lit a fire.

takdir.name: The King's Gratitude
takdir.text: Be a Councillor when Fealty is sent.

gozden.name: Fall From Grace
gozden.flavor: The higher you climb, the further you fall.

kulisci.name: Many Webs
kulisci.text: Place Schemes on three different players.

yukselen.name: The King's Favorite
yukselen.text: Be a Councillor in two Crises.
yukselen.flavor: Rising is easy. Staying up is not.

hedef.name: Knives in the Dark
hedef.text: Have other players place 2 or more Schemes on you in one Crisis.
hedef.flavor: Every knife in the room points your way.

ortak.name: Back a Champion
ortak.text: Place King's Seal or Tourney Wager on a Councillor.

koltuk.name: Seize a Seat
koltuk.text: Become a Councillor through a Scheme.
koltuk.flavor: No chair stays empty for long.

kulak.name: Listen at Doors
kulak.text: Use Shadowed, Opened Letters, Inquiry or Standing Guard.
kulak.flavor: The walls have ears, and so do the cellars.

yeniceri.name: Swords in the Street
yeniceri.text: Players with 0 Favor draw 1 Scheme each.

hazine.name: The Crown's Debts
hazine.text: Nobody can draw a Scheme this Crisis.

venedik.name: The Iron Bank's Envoy
venedik.text: The players on either side of the King draw 1 Scheme each.

harem.name: Scandal on the Street of Silk
harem.text: The player with the least Favor draws 1 Scheme; on a tie the King picks.

macar.name: Raids in the Riverlands
macar.text: Nobody draws a Scheme this Crisis.

muhur.name: The Death of Jon Arryn
muhur.text: Last Crisis's Councillors draw 1 Scheme each.

divan.name: A Quarrel in Council
divan.text: Last Crisis's Councillors draw 1 Scheme each.

sehzade.name: The Heir in Question
sehzade.text: The players on either side of the King draw 1 Scheme each.

istanbul.name: The Hand's Tourney
istanbul.text: Everyone but the King draws 1 Scheme.

irakeyn.name: The Targaryen Threat
irakeyn.text: The player with the least Favor draws 1 Scheme; on a tie the King picks.

isabella.name: Trouble on the Kingsroad
isabella.text: Last Crisis's Councillors draw 1 Scheme each.
isabella.flavor: A butcher's boy, a direwolf and a prince's pride. Somebody pays for it.

h.name: Fealty
text: Judgment: the King gives a Councillor 1 Favor.

x.name: Treachery
text: Judgment: the King takes 1 Favor from a Councillor.
x.flavor: «Your Grace, I swear I did all I could.»

loyalist.name: Sworn
text: You win with 4 Fealty on the King's Peace.

traitor.name: Oathbreaker
text: You win with 5 Treachery on the Conspiracy.

sorusturma.name: The Seed Is Strong
sorusturma.text: The King names an Inquirer, who looks in secret at one player's Oath, then says whatever they like.

hazineDefteri.name: The Rookery
hazineDefteri.text: Before the next Crisis the King names a player, who looks in secret at the top 3 Ravens.

fermanRefresh.name: A New Command
fermanRefresh.text: The King may use Royal Command again. He never holds more than one.

strings.tagline: There's a traitor in the Red Keep.
strings.endTreason: The fifth {term.hiyanet} is sent. {term.suleyman:the} is dead.
strings.pref.music.why: A quiet loop in D minor.
strings.err.exiled: A banished player can't be {term.minister:a} this {term.crisis}.
strings.log.surgun: {who} is banished this {term.crisis}: they can't be {term.minister:a}.
strings.ask.appoint: Name two {term.minister:pl}. You can't name yourself.
strings.ask.appointSadrazam: {power.sadrazam}: you name both {term.minister:pl}; you may name yourself.
strings.window.sadrazam: This {term.crisis}, you name both {term.minister:pl} instead of {term.suleyman:the}.
strings.err.ownSeat: You can't Challenge your own seat.
strings.ask.objectNotSelf: You can't Challenge your own seat, but you can Challenge the other.
strings.wait.objectionLast: {now} may Challenge now; theirs is the last word.
strings.wait.kader: Ravens: nobody talks, nobody shows a card.
strings.ask.kaderSecond: {first} sent you two Ravens. Send one.
strings.window.gozcu: You may look in secret at the card the {term.min1} burned.
strings.ask.appointHow: Tap the seat for the {term.min1}, then the one for the {term.min2}.
